page.layout: One page of text in a single column; Hebrew headword at top with running head "אד" centred; no margin notes; signature "A 3" at foot left.

main_text.p: אָדוֹן m. Dominus, quasi Basis suorum dicitus. Dicitur de Deo & hominibus: plur. אֲדֹנִים Hinc אֲדֹנָי cum Kametz, de Deo tantum: אֲדֹנַי cum Pathach, Domini mei, de hominibus & angelis, ut Gen.19.2.
אֲדִין Chald. Tunc: בֶּאדִין idem, Dan. 2.12.
אַדֵּר אַדֵּר נֶאְדַּר Magnificus: נֶאְדָּרִי idem: quibusdam est paragogicum: aliis per apocopam, pro נֶאְדָּרִית. Ex Hiphil, וַיַּאְדִּיר Et magnificum reddidit, Jesa.42.21.
אַדִּיר m. Magnificus, Validus: plur. אַדִּירִים.
אַדְרָה m. Adrat f. Magnificentia: metonymice Toga, Pallium magnificum vel magnificentiæ indicium.
אֲדָר m. Adar, mensis duodecimi nomen, Februario respondens. Chal. Esr.6.15.
אֶדְרָא אֲדֵרֵי Chald. Area, Horreum: plural. אֲדֵרֵי קַיִט Area æstatis, Dan.2.35.
אַדְרְנָזְרֵיָא m. p. Chald. Senatores, judices.
אָהַב אָהַב Amavit, Dilexit. Niphal נֶאֱהַב Amatus fuit. Ex Pihel Part. מְאַהֲבִים Amantes, Amatores, Amici.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation in the headwords is approximate; the scan is small and some points are doubtful. Two small marks (bullet and a dash near "Expedite") are printing ornaments, not text.
